description: Save subject-profile aspect entry for current student. Payload shape depends on aspectEntryType. All entry types use request-only data with clean success response.

request.aspectEntryType: manualRemark | grade | emoji | listOfValue | marks | performanceEfforts

notes.nextStudentId: Returned when Save and Next is used; omit on Save only.
notes.sharedFields: groupId, subGroupId, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds on all entry types where visible in Remarks UI.

conditionalFields.manualRemark: skills[] with skillId + remark, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds — list GET: 19230-58386--manual-remark-list.json; save POST: 19230-58386--manual-remark-entry.json
conditionalFields.grade: aspects[] with aspectId + gradeId, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds — list GET: 19230-58100--grade-list.json; save POST: 19230-58100--grade-entry.json
conditionalFields.emoji: aspects[] with aspectId + emojiId, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds — list GET: 19230-58190--emoji-list.json; save POST: 19230-58190--emoji-entry.json
conditionalFields.listOfValue: aspects[] with aspectId + valueId + remark, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds — list GET: 19230-58283--list-of-value-list.json; save POST: 19230-58283--list-of-value-entry.json
conditionalFields.marks: maximumMarks, aspects[] with aspectId + marks + gradeId, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds — list GET: 19230-58426--marks-list.json; save POST: 19230-58426--marks-entry.json
conditionalFields.performanceEfforts: criteria[] with criteriaId + performance + efforts, overallRemarks, selectedSuggestionIds — list GET: 19230-57868--performance-efforts-list.json; save POST: 19230-58576--performance-efforts-entry.json
